title: armeria bourgaei subsp. lanceobracteata
intro: Armeria bourgaei subsp. lanceobracteata, commonly known as Bourgae's Thrift or Mountain Thrift, is a type of flowering plant belonging to the Plantaginaceae family. This plant is known for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health issues, including digestive problems, fever, and respiratory infections, due to its anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antiviral properties. The therapeutic actions of Armeria bourgaei subsp. lanceobracteata include reducing inflammation, fighting off infections, and soothing the digestive system. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
